title: AGDecode: Semantic Attribute Grammar Derivatives for Safety-Constrained Decoding of Large Language Models
title_zh: AGDecode：用于大语言模型安全约束解码的语义属性文法导数

paragraphs.en: 提出基于属性文法与不动点语义的约束解码框架，可强制空指针安全等语义属性且开销可控。 Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for code generation, motivating techniques that guarantee the structural and semantic correctness of generated programs. Constrained decoding enforces correctness during generation by restricting token choices to those that admit at least one valid completion. While existing approaches can enforce syntactic constraints and selected semantic properties such as type safety, they either target specific properties or rely on operational pruning mechanisms that are difficult to generalize to data-dependent, inductive program properties. We present AGDecode, a programmable framework for semantic constrained decoding based on least-fixed-point semantics. AGDecode extends attribute grammars to partially constructed syntax trees, and reduces semantic constrained decoding to a realizability problem over such trees. The framework compiles semantic specifications into systems of relational constraints that are discharged by external verification oracles, such as SMT and CHC solvers, cleanly separating language semantics from constraint-solving machinery. We prove that our approach is sound and complete relative to an ideal verification oracle. In practice, solvers inevitably encounter uncertain queries; conservatively, our system can reject tokens for soundness or speculatively continue to generate until later queries resolve the entire generation. We mechanize the core metatheory in Rocq and evaluate the framework on semantic-constrained generation of C programs, enforcing path-sensitive safety properties including null-pointer safety, division-by-zero freedom, and initialized-variable usage. Our results demonstrate that solver-backed semantic constrained decoding can enforce rich semantic guarantees while incurring modest computational overhead at regular program boundaries.
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）日益被用于代码生成，这促使人们研究保证所生成程序结构与语义正确性的技术。我们提出一个基于属性文法与不动点语义的约束解码框架，可强制空指针安全等语义属性且开销可控。 约束解码在生成过程中强制正确性，它将 token 的选择限制在那些至少存在一个有效补全的候选上。 虽然现有方法可以强制语法约束以及类型安全等特定语义性质，但它们要么只针对特定性质，要么依赖难以泛化到数据相关的归纳式程序性质的操作性剪枝机制。 我们提出 AGDecode，一个基于最小不动点语义的可编程语义约束解码框架。 AGDecode 将属性文法扩展到部分构造的语法树，并将语义约束解码归约为此类树上的可实现性问题。 该框架将语义规范编译为关系约束系统，这些约束由外部验证 oracle（如 SMT 求解器和 CHC 求解器）来消解，从而将语言语义与约束求解机制清晰地分离。 我们证明了相对于理想验证 oracle，我们的方法是可靠且完备的。 在实践中，求解器不可避免地会遇到不确定的查询；保守起见，为保证可靠性，我们的系统可以拒绝相应 token，或者推测性地继续生成，直到后续查询解决整个生成。 我们在 Rocq 中机械化证明了核心元理论，并在 C 程序的语义约束生成上评估了该框架，强制路径敏感的安全性性质，包括空指针安全、避免除零以及已初始化变量的使用。 我们的结果表明，基于求解器的语义约束解码能够强制丰富的语义保证，同时在常规程序边界处仅带来适度的计算开销。
